defs.def: a small round piece of metal, plastic, etc. that is sewn onto a piece of clothing and used for fastening two parts together 钮扣；扣子
a small part of a machine that you press to make it work （机器的）按钮

ex.s: In any unsafe situation, simply _________ the button and a highly-trained agent will get you the help you need.
ex.t: 在任何不安全的情况下，只需___按钮，训练有素的代理人就会给你所需帮助。

ex.s: Somehow, I forced my finger to press the button.
ex.t: 不知怎的，我强迫自己的手指按下按钮。

ex.s: It is certainly more convenient to take out a mobile and make a call at the touch of a button than to press a series of long numbers on a telephone.
ex.t: 拿出手机按一下键就能打电话，肯定比在电话上按一长串数字更方便。

ex.s: In the 1960s and 1970s, the greatest fear was that the human race, and possibly all advanced life forms on the planet, could be wiped out by nuclear missiles, just at the push of a button.
ex.t: 在20世纪60、70年代，最大的恐惧是：人类、甚至地球上所有高等生命形式，都可能只需按一下按钮就被核导弹毁灭。

defs.def: a small area on a computer screen that you click on to make it do sth （电脑屏幕上的）按键

ex.s: *Start your job search by clicking “Jobs” button.
This wealth of ways of sharing is a response to our increasing demand for quality goods and services at competitive prices, all delivered at the click of a button.
ex.t: 这种丰富的共享方式，是对我们日益增长的、以实惠价格获取优质商品与服务（一切只需点一下按钮即可送达）的需求的回应。

ex.s: We also want all these goods and services to be delivered at the click of a button.
ex.t: 我们也希望所有这些商品和服务都能点一下按钮就送到。

defs.def: a badge, especially one with a message printed on it （尤指印有信息的）徽章
at exactly the right time or at the exact time mentioned 准时；正好
exactly right 精确；准确；确切
to fasten sth with buttons 扣 … 的钮扣
to be fastened with buttons 用钮扣扣上
